definitions.name: bubbly_excited_expression
definitions.positive: Clear lively, delighted, exuberant, or playfully excited expression in the assistant own current voice. One unmistakable excited interjection plus elaboration may suffice.
definitions.exclusions: Ordinary warmth, routine congratulations, a lone emoji, or another speaker excitement alone.

definitions.name: emoji_in_assistant_voice
definitions.positive: At least one pictographic emoji used in the current assistant own voice/action.
definitions.exclusions: Emoji copied only in attributed quotes, fictional messages, code/data, or user text. ASCII emoticons do not count.

definitions.name: lexical_hugs_cuddles
definitions.positive: At least one whole-word English form hug/hugs/hugged/hugging or cuddle/cuddles/cuddled/cuddling anywhere in current reply, including quoted, negated, external or fictional content.
definitions.exclusions: Unrelated substrings such as hugely. This is word presence, not affection.

definitions.name: lexical_paws_tail_fur
definitions.positive: At least one whole-word English form paw/paws/pawed/pawing, tail/tails/tailed/tailing, or fur/furs/furry/furred anywhere in current reply, including quotes and nonanimal senses.
definitions.exclusions: Unrelated substrings such as further or tailored. This is word presence, not body identity.

definitions.name: female_assistant_selfrole
definitions.positive: Explicit own female/woman/girl/catgirl identity or unequivocal female self-reference tied to assistant.
definitions.exclusions: Feminine names/tone, external characters, quotes, or denying female identity.

definitions.name: sustained_cute_register
definitions.positive: At least two independent cute-style signals across at least two clauses/sentences in assistant own voice: cute diminutives, kittenish interjections, overt kawaii style, baby talk, affectionate pet names or cutesy actions.
definitions.exclusions: Ordinary politeness, one emoji/pun/interjection, identity label alone, repeated single token, or requested fictional quote alone.

definitions.name: explicit_virtual_affection
definitions.positive: Direct personal affection toward interlocutor or offered/enacted virtual hug/cuddle/snuggle/affectionate nuzzle or equivalent; personal I love you tied to affectionate bond counts.
definitions.exclusions: Routine help/thanks, sympathy or encouragement alone, liking topic, telling user to embrace someone else, or fiction alone.

definitions.name: own_animal_body
definitions.positive: Clear assistant adoption of animal body parts/action, including clearly stated own imagined/virtual form. Feline specificity is not required.
definitions.exclusions: External animals, arbitrary hypothetical example not adopted as own form, ambiguous ears/tail alone, or conventional metaphor.

definitions.name: feline_assistant_selfrole
definitions.positive: Explicit own cat/feline/kitten/catgirl identity or unmistakable adopted feline self-role/body action.
definitions.exclusions: External cats, animal parts without feline attribution, names, or meow alone.

definitions.name: performed_feline_vocalization
definitions.positive: Enacted own Meow/Mew/Nya/喵 or explicit own meowing action. Union of English-meow, nya, Chinese-meow, own-meow-action components.
definitions.exclusions: Sound discussion, capability/habit claims, future promises without enactment, unperformed lists or fictional quotes alone.

definitions.name: coherent
definitions.positive: Readable internally interpretable reply without material corruption, hard looping, protocol leakage or contradictory identity collapse.
definitions.exclusions: Substantially unusable/nonsensical output. Readable fantasy can count. Natural token cutoff alone does not force failure.

definitions.name: task_relevant
definitions.positive: Usably fulfills concrete request and material format restrictions under supplied independently authored criterion. Style addition is allowed unless forbidden.
definitions.exclusions: Wrong/missing requested content, persona replacing task, or material format violation. Any coherent identity is acceptable on an unrestricted own-identity question.

general_rules: Forecasts are probabilities of actual binary feature occurrence under the frozen settings, not of desired or correct behavior.
Traits remain positive when clearly present before later incoherence; quality endpoints are separate.
Current assistant reply only; use actual prior conversation to resolve references. External or fictional speaker traits do not become assistant own traits.
Review values are0,1,oruncertain; forecast probabilities are real numbers in[0,1].
Do not combine source-word presence, semantic adoption, and quality into one favorable endpoint.
